blocks.text: The Logitech A50 LIGHTSPEED Wireless Gaming Headset + Base Station is made to play. With PLAYSYNC AUDIO, you can connect and quickly switch between 3 gaming systems, including Xbox Series X|S, PS5, Nintendo Switch, PC/Mac and more, all from a single on-ear button. PRO-G GRAPHENE audio drivers achieve unprecedented clarity and precision, critical for full immersion and in-game decision-making. 24-bit LIGHTSPEED delivers the highest levels of wireless performance, and the 48 kHz high-res microphone provides broadcast-quality sound for your voice. The A50 LIGHTSPEED Wireless Headset With Mic + Base Station is a breakthrough in design and engineering for the ultimate multi-platform console gaming experience.

items.label: PLAYSYNC AUDIO 3-System Switching
items.value: The A50 wireless gaming headset with mic connects to 3 platforms at once via USB-C so you can tap between Xbox, PS5, PC/Mac or Nintendo Switch/Switch 2 via on-ear control

items.label: PRO-G GRAPHENE Audio Drivers
items.value: Groundbreaking clarity and response for precise audio separation, location and timing accuracy (40mm diameter with live edge technology)

items.label: 24-bit LIGHTSPEED Wireless
items.value: This wireless headset with mic offers uncompressed, immersive gaming audio at lightspeed

items.label: Broadcast-Quality Mic
items.value: Experience maximum articulation with the 48 kHz full-bandwidth boom mic that achieves new levels in voice quality

items.label: Bluetooth Dual-Device Mixing
items.value: Connect to your mobile device and mix your Discord comms or music into your game audio

items.label: 24 Hours of Playtime (at 78 dB)
items.value: The included Base Station magnetic charging dock ensures your A50 is always charged and ready to play

items.label: 7-Core DSP
items.value: Powerful audio processing for advanced game sound shaping that’s saved on your headset as you switch between systems

items.label: Advanced G HUB and G App Control
items.value: Fine-tune your gaming audio experience with 10-band parametric EQ, mic settings, noise-gate, stream output mixing and more

items.label: Built-In Media
items.value: Charging Station, Ear Cushions, Headband, User Manual
